QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] To the Summit
QuestInfo.0: There doesn't seem to be much information to be found beneath Crimsonwood Mountain. That being the case, maybe going the other direction will get results! Join Becky in climbing to the top of Crimsonwood Mountain.
